newsitem.title: FRANCE: TENNIS-DAY 10 SNIPPETS FROM ROLAND GARROS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-DAY 10 SNIPPETS FROM ROLAND GARROS.

text.p: A brief selection of highlights from the 10th day of the French Open:

Best quote - "The only thing that hurt me was my foot." Sergi Bruguera, who tore ligaments in his right ankle in 1995, when asked if he was hurt to see other Spaniards move past him in the world rankings last year.
Stat of the day - 28. The number of years since an Australian, Rod Laver, won the French Open. Patrick Rafter is the first in the semifinals since Phil Dent in 1977.

Three unseeded players in the semis - For the first time, there will be three unseeded players in the French Open men's semifinals -- Belgian Filip Dewulf, Brazilian Gustavo Kuerten and Australian Patrick Rafter. There were two in 1973 and 1994. The last unseeded player to win the tournament was Sweden's Mats Wilander in 1982.
